title: Trump backs calls for reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
summary_full: As tech industry pushes for return, US president says he thinks Huang ‘learned a big lesson’Donald Trump has expressed support for the return of Jensen Huang as the chief executive of Nvidia, joining Silicon Valley heavyweights in backing the reinstatement of the AI figurehead.The US president referred to a tech industry campaign for Huang’s rehabilitation, saying a “big group” of people would like him back.
